title: Rav Acha son of Rav Nachman
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 114a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.114a.2), but [Berakhot 43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.43b.15) reads Mar Zutra son of Rav Nachman; Hyman reports the same reading in Dikdukei Soferim for Shabbat there.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Shabbat calls him Rabbi Acha son of Rav Nachman. Hyman’s heading and [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=336&lang=en) say Rav Acha.
In Berakhot, Mar Zutra son of Rav Nachman gives the explanation about one patch over another. Hyman reports that name for Shabbat from Dikdukei Soferim.
